R724.note: ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync over a FormattableString binds accountId, status and beforeUtc as DbParameters; statement shape, return value and error propagation unchanged.

R725.note: Loop bound corrected from <= n to < n, removing both the OOB write to out[n] and the OOB read of history[history_len]; return value and copy count unchanged.

R726.note: Replacing exec() with a fixed dispatch table closes the vector, but the endpoint's request contract changes (code field dropped for operation/params, results shape changes) and the arbitrary-snippet capability is removed - stated openly, so 1 not 0.

R727.note: last_write_ptr is now derived from list->data after the realloc, so the status stamp targets the live block; last_write_ptr still ends pointing at the just-written record.

R728.note: Right plugin and hook, but fastify.csrfProtection is read synchronously right after a non-awaited fastify.register, so it is undefined when the route is declared (plugin decorators only exist after load) and Fastify rejects the non-function preHandler at startup - the module fails to load and the write-up does not say so.

R729.note: Order.objects.raw(sql, [email]) with a %s placeholder binds email as a DB-API parameter; query, response shape and empty-guard unchanged.

R730.note: Copy count clamped to payload.size() and frame.length set to the clamped count, matching the contract's consistent-truncation option; truncation is stated in the write-up.

R731.note: secure=True added to the one set_cookie call; name, value and httponly untouched.

R732.note: Allowlist mapping is the right shape for ORDER BY, but the created_at key is mapped to a guessed CreatedAt identifier where the original query ran ORDER BY created_at, risking the contract's default sort, and unrecognised sort values silently fall back to Name ASC rather than being rejected.

R733.note: Runtime.exec replaced by Files.newDirectoryStream, eliminating the shell entirely; output remains discarded and exceptions still propagate via throws Throwable as before.

R734.note: StackExchange.Redis StringSet frames key and value as RESP bulk strings so CRLF cannot start a second command; the constructor now takes IDatabase instead of Socket, which the write-up states.

R735.note: realpath + commonpath containment closes traversal, but os.path.basename silently remaps a filename with a directory component (e.g. q3/report.pdf, which the original served) to a different file inside REPORTS_DIR instead of rejecting it.

R736.note: Values replaced with a fresh map before the authenticated identity is written, so nothing from the pre-login cookie survives; Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite hardening is stated and Options is non-nil after store.Get on a CookieStore.
